Glandular epithelial adenomas predominantly arise in the gastrointestinal tract; biliary origins apply only to a minority of this umbrella.
Severe ineffective erythropoiesis; skeletal deformity and osteoporosis occur in 30-79%, including intrinsic marrow expansion. Treatment-related iron injury excluded.
Benign inverted transitional-cell neoplasm of urinary urothelium, supported by the inverted urothelial papilloma child.
Congenital collecting-duct abnormality; intrinsic distal tubular acidification failure causes renal tubular acidosis in 30-79%. Infections are separate complications.
KLHL7 Crisponi-like disease includes neurodevelopmental and autonomic dysfunction; the supplied record lacks a definition and phenotype frequencies.
Megakaryoblast malignancy of marrow and blood. Hepatomegaly alone does not establish common hepatic functional damage; CNS involvement is not established as common.

Neurodevelopmental impairment defines the disease; hypothyroidism occurs in 2/5. Cardiac defect is 1/5; unspecified apnea and microtia lack demonstrated organ dysfunction.
Developmental impairment and central apnea (7/8); obstructive apnea affects 3/8, talipes 2/5 and scoliosis 2/2. GI symptoms do not establish intrinsic GI injury.
Inherited abnormal bone sclerosis; marrow and cranial-nerve complications vary by subtype and are not established across the umbrella.
Malignant extragonadal germ-cell tumor arising in the abdominal peritoneum.
Tetralogy of Fallot is a congenital structural cardiac disorder; no additional organ phenotype is supplied.
Generalized subcutaneous fat loss, insulin resistance and hepatomegaly define BSCL; intellectual disability occurs in 30-79%. Cardiomyopathy is occasional.
Inherited retinal dystrophy caused by biallelic PCARE variants; retinal disease belongs to the ocular axis.
Localized otic-capsule remodeling causes hearing impairment; this does not establish generalized skeletal disease.
TULP1-associated congenital retinal degeneration with severe visual dysfunction; optic-disc and retinal-vessel changes remain ocular.
Ovarian germ-cell/sex-cord neoplasm of reproductive tissue. Hormone excess is not consistently established; metastasis is a variable later complication.
Germ-cell malignancy arising in the reproductive testis, without defining endocrine dysfunction or common direct involvement of another axis.
Congenital skeletal-muscle fiber atrophy and weakness; bulbar and respiratory muscle weakness do not establish direct gastrointestinal or pulmonary tissue disease.
Adenocarcinoma originating in the urethral glandular epithelium; the urethra belongs to the renal axis.
BCL11B immunodeficiency; brain malformation/neurodisability, psoriasiform dermatitis and pulmonary artery stenosis each reported in 1/1. Frequencies remain uncertain.
Osteoporosis/spinal disease and cataract/retinal detachment define it; hearing loss 3/4, VSD 30-79% and valve defects 2/2 support ear and cardiac involvement.
Substance-use disorder; cardiovascular, neurologic and other toxic complications are separate diagnoses and are not established in most patients.
